name: Wocheneinkauf
tagline: Shared shopping list for family and flatmates, synced live - no account
blurb: Wocheneinkauf is a simple shared shopping list for families and flatmates.
description:
Wocheneinkauf is a simple shared shopping list for families and flatmates. Create a list, share the link – everyone who opens it is in. No account, no tracking, no ads.

Features

• Add, edit, check off and remove items – changes show up on all open phones immediately

• Bulk mode: "tomatoes, cheese, milk" becomes three items

• Automatic emojis for groceries (German and English item names), tolerant of typos; an emoji you type or pick yourself always wins

• Word suggestions while typing; a tap adds the item

• Emoji picker with search (English and German) for keyboards without emojis

• Drag items into your own order, e.g. along the route through the shop – shared with everyone on the list

• Photos instead of text ("this brand"), tap to enlarge; remembered photos are suggested again when you add items

• Shows who added an item

• Share a list by link, QR code or code; anyone can rename it

• Material You design, dark mode, English and German

Server

The app needs a Wocheneinkauf server – there is no public default server. The server is part of the same open source project (FastAPI + SQLite, Docker image) and runs on a home server or a small VPS; enter its URL on first start, or open a share link, which brings the server along. Anyone who has a list's link or code can read and change that list; lists that are not used for a while are deleted automatically.
